raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.30.1"
  python_check_max: "3.14"
  cargo_wrapper: cargo-auditable-wrapper${{ ".sh" if unix else ".bat" }}
  unlink_tests: test_build_backend.py

package:
  name: pyproject-fmt
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/p/pyproject-fmt/pyproject_fmt-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: b2cc23c09b068dcdb00360f3eb59882d74e626e0784e73f0356a3791378a2e5c

build:
  number: 1
  skip: is_abi3 and not is_python_min
  python:
    version_independent: ${{ is_abi3 }}
    entry_points:
      - pyproject-fmt = pyproject_fmt.__main__:runner
  script:
    env:
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: fat
      CARGO: ${{ cargo_wrapper }}
      PYTHONIOENCODING: utf-8
      PYTHONLEGACYTEXTENCODING: utf-8
    content:
      - if: win
        then:
          - copy "%RECIPE_DIR%\${{ cargo_wrapper }}" "%BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\bin\"
        else:
          - cp "${RECIPE_DIR}/${{ cargo_wrapper }}" "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/"
          - chmod 755 "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/${{ cargo_wrapper }}"
      - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check --check-build-dependencies
      - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("rust") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cargo-auditable
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
  host:
    - maturin >=1.15
    - pip
    - python
    - if: is_abi3
      then:
        - python-abi3
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
  run:
    - python
    - if: is_abi3
      then:
        - python-abi3
        - python >=${{ python_min }}

tests:
  - package_contents:
      strict: true
      bin:
        - if: not is_abi3
          then:
            - pyproject-fmt
      files:
        - etc/conda/test-files/pyproject-fmt/**
        - if: win and not is_abi3
          then:
            - Scripts/pyproject-fmt-script.py
      site_packages:
        - pyproject_fmt/**
        - pyproject_fmt-${{ version }}.dist-info/**
  - python:
      imports: pyproject_fmt
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - if: is_abi3
          then:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - ${{ python_check_max }}.*
          else:
            - "*"
  - files:
      recipe:
        - run_test.py
      source:
        - pyproject-fmt/tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - pytest >=9.1.1
        - pytest-cov >=7.1
        - pytest-mock >=3.16
        - trove-classifiers >=2026.9.21.13
        - if: is_abi3
          then:
            - abi3audit
            - python !=${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - pyproject-fmt --help
      - python -c "import os; [os.unlink(f'pyproject-fmt/tests/{p}') for p in '''${{ unlink_tests }}'''.split()]"
      # also runs abi3audit, if available
      - python run_test.py --python-min=${{ python_min }}

about:
  summary: Format your pyproject.toml file
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.txt
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/pyproject-fmt
  repository: https://github.com/tox-dev/toml-fmt
  documentation: https://pyproject-fmt.readthedocs.io

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - bollwyvl
